experiment.central_question: Can the frozen HC-1.5 Health semantic foundation, using the repaired acquisition/currentness governance path frozen before Product #8 selection, manufacture and certify copayment and waiting-period knowledge for a neutral unseen current Health product without new semantic runtime logic or structural shape?

baseline_separation.semantic_scoring_baseline_purpose: Classify semantic handling as REUSE, CONFIG_SPEC, REPRESENTATION_GAP or KNOWLEDGE_GAP against the frozen HC-1.5 foundation.
baseline_separation.experiment_governance_baseline_purpose: Freeze the already-built acquisition, source-observation, currentness and v4.2 evidence-eligibility controls before Product #8 selection.

allowed_source_classes: current regulator insurer list or insurer registry page
official insurer non-policy HTML product catalogue/download index containing identity metadata only
official insurer disclaimer or product-list page containing product identity/UIN metadata only
official regulator product/UIN table explicitly limited to product metadata
prohibited_source_classes_before_selecti: rate chart or premium chart PDF
FAQ or marketing page containing target-concept mechanics
search-result or AI-generated snippet containing copayment or waiting-period mechanics for a candidate insurer/product
preselection_metadata_firewall.contamination_rule: If any prohibited surface exposes copayment or waiting-period mechanics for an insurer before Product #8 selection is committed, immediately stop screening that insurer, record the exposure, exclude that insurer from Product #8, and do not use the exposed content for selection or scoring.
preselection_metadata_firewall.metadata_insufficiency_rule: If product identity, retail Health indemnity eligibility, individual/family-floater availability, exact UIN/version identity, or current-offering status cannot be established from allowed metadata-only surfaces, exclude the candidate without opening a prohibited document.

preselection_currentness_firewall.purpose: Prevent a repeat of Product #7 selecting a superseded version while keeping target mechanics unseen.
preselection_currentness_firewall.minimum_metadata_currentness_evidence: The same exact product identity and UIN/version must be corroborated by at least two allowed official metadata surfaces, including at least one current insurer-controlled metadata surface and one regulator metadata surface when such regulator product metadata is available; otherwise use a second independent insurer-controlled metadata surface. A single metadata surface is insufficient.

selection_protocol.insurer_sort: normalized insurer legal/display name lower-case ASCII ascending
selection_protocol.screening_rule: Screen non-excluded insurers in order using only allowed metadata surfaces until the first insurer has at least one contamination-free, metadata-verifiable, currentness-corroborated retail Health indemnity product with no governed exact-UIN exposure at the semantic scoring baseline.
selection_protocol.stopping_rule: Stop at the first eligible uncontaminated insurer.
selection_protocol.selected_insurer_ledger_rule: Record every metadata-verifiable candidate reviewed for the selected insurer, its exact UIN/version signals, currentness corroboration sources, and eligibility/exclusion reason without reading target mechanics.
selection_protocol.product_tie_break: Sort eligible currentness-corroborated products by normalized UIN/product identifier ascending and select the first.

required_sequence: acquire exact selected product source bytes through the frozen C2 acquisition path
register immutable source bytes and SHA-256
create or reuse governed product identity reference for the selected exact UIN/version
create source observation bound to the exact registered document version
establish reviewed document identity/currentness through document_identity_resolution_overlay_v1
require CurrentProductRepeatabilityEvidenceEligibility to return eligible for the exact document version and SHA-256
only then permit reading copayment or waiting-period target clauses

classification_rubric.REUSE: The HC-1.5 baseline generic contracts, binders, certifiers, semantic types, governed spec schemas and evidence-attribution shapes handle the concept unchanged, and the exact evidence also passes the v4.2 current-product eligibility gate.
classification_rubric.CONFIG_SPEC: Frozen semantic runtime remains unchanged but a new governed declarative structural shape is required; no executable decision logic may be hidden in it, and the exact evidence passes the v4.2 current-product eligibility gate.
classification_rubric.REPRESENTATION_GAP: Authoritative current evidence is sufficient but the frozen HC-1.5 baseline cannot faithfully represent or certify the semantic shape.
classification_rubric.KNOWLEDGE_GAP: Reviewed authoritative/corroborating current evidence is insufficient; code, config or DomainKnowledge cannot compensate.
classification_rubric.UNSCORABLE_CURRENTNESS_OR_ACQUISITION: The selected product cannot reach exact governed currentness/evidence eligibility before semantic inspection. This is an operational experiment failure/closure, not a semantic classification.

success_bar.STRONG_REPEATABILITY_PROVEN: Both target concepts are REUSE, every primary metric remains zero, and every scored claim passes semantic correctness plus v4.2 current-product evidence eligibility.
success_bar.MINIMUM_REPEATABILITY_PROVEN: Both target concepts are REUSE or CONFIG_SPEC, at least one is REUSE, no REPRESENTATION_GAP occurs, every primary metric remains zero, and every scored claim passes semantic correctness plus v4.2 current-product evidence eligibility.
success_bar.REPEATABILITY_NOT_PROVEN: Any primary metric is non-zero, any target concept is REPRESENTATION_GAP, or both scoreable concepts are CONFIG_SPEC with zero REUSE.
success_bar.REPEATABILITY_INCONCLUSIVE: At least one target concept is KNOWLEDGE_GAP and no architecture/repeatability failure otherwise occurs.
success_bar.EXPERIMENT_UNSCORED: Selection is immutable but exact acquisition/currentness/evidence eligibility fails before semantic review; do not replace the product/version or infer a semantic outcome.

required_artifacts_before_semantic_revie: complete metadata-only ledger for the selected insurer
preselection currentness corroboration ledger with no unresolved conflicting UIN/version signals
attestation that no prohibited product document was opened before selection merge
exact registered source artifact and SHA-256
reviewed document_identity_resolution_overlay_v1 for the exact selected version
positive CurrentProductRepeatabilityEvidenceEligibility result for the exact selected document version and SHA-256
